title: File:"Keep Buffalo a Secret" mural, Main Street, Buffalo, New York - 20201220.jpg
author: Andre Carrotflower
description: The controversial motto "KEEP BUFFALO A SECRET" - made well-known by the locally-based Oxford Pennant Company - is seen as a mural on the north side of the building at 810 Main Street, in the Allentown section of the city, in this December 2020 photo.
